description: This file implements an RPC client for internal parallel support in the Ginkgo testing framework, handling communication with a server for test suite coordination.

classes.name: rpcClient
classes.description: A client for RPC communication with the test server, managing connection and various report and control methods.

methods.name: newRPCClient
methods.description: Creates a new rpcClient instance with the specified server host.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes an RPC connection to the server if not already connected.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Repeatedly calls a server method until success or a specific error occurs, with handling for polling intervals and errors.

methods.name: PostSuiteWillBegin
methods.description: Notifies the server that a test suite is about to begin.

methods.name: PostDidRun
methods.description: Reports that a test has run.

methods.name: PostSuiteDidEnd
methods.description: Notifies the server that a test suite has ended.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends output data to the server.

methods.name: PostReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Indicates that the report before suite completion has been sent.

methods.name: BlockUntilReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Blocks until the server reports that the 'before suite' report is complete.

methods.name: PostSynchronizedBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Notifies the server that a synchronized 'before suite' step has completed.

methods.name: BlockUntilSynchronizedBeforeSuiteData
methods.description: Blocks until synchronized 'before suite' data is available from the server.

methods.name: BlockUntilNonprimaryProcsHaveFinished
methods.description: Blocks until non-primary processes have finished.

methods.name: BlockUntilAggregatedNonprimaryProcsReport
methods.description: Blocks until an aggregated report from non-primary processes is available.

methods.name: FetchNextCounter
methods.description: Fetches the next counter value from the server.

methods.name: ShouldAbort
methods.description: Checks if the server has signaled to abort.
